description: This file defines structures, types, and function prototypes related to input stream handling in the FreeType library, including stream object definitions, class structures, and function pointer types for reading and seeking within streams.

classes.name: FT_Stream_ClassRec
classes.description: Describes an input stream class with methods for reading and seeking.

classes.name: FT_StreamRec
classes.description: Represents an input stream object with properties like size, position, and data pointers.

methods.name: ft_stream_new_memory
methods.description: Creates a new memory-based stream from a given data buffer.

methods.name: ft_stream_new_iso
methods.description: Creates a new stream from an ISO file given its path.
